name: EmptyState
description: Placeholder for empty collections, zero-result searches and unconfigured features, with title, description and action slots.
designIntent: Empty states are where users decide what to do next. A consistent icon/title/description/action hierarchy beats ad-hoc 'No data' strings, and a stable structure is easier for screen readers and tests.

props.name: description
props.description: Supporting line explaining the next step.

props.name: actions
props.description: Alias for `action` for codebases that pass a list of actions.

props.name: secondaryAction
props.description: Secondary action beside the primary one.

props.name: titleAs
props.description: Heading level for the title. Defaults to a paragraph.

examples.title: Empty collection
examples.code:
<EmptyState
  title="No classes yet"
  description="Create your first class to get started."
  action={<Button>New class</Button>}
/>
examples.description: Title, explanation and one primary action.

antiPatterns.title: Don't use it for errors
antiPatterns.explanation: Empty is a normal state; failures need Alert/ErrorAlert with retry affordances.

accessibility.implementation: Actions are whatever you pass — use Button/link components so they stay focusable and announced
accessibility.userRequirements: Always provide a real control, not a bare sentence

goodExamples: No classes yet — create your first class

compositionRules.relationship: Often rendered inside a Card body or a DataTable empty slot
